description: This Java class 'InventoryWorker' provides utility methods for managing and querying inventory and order data, including fetching outstanding purchase orders, calculating outstanding quantities, and retrieving product quantities for specific order types within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: InventoryWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for inventory and order management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getOutstandingPurchaseOrders
methods.description: Retrieves all outstanding purchase orders for a given productId, excluding completed, canceled, or rejected orders.

methods.name: getOutstandingPurchasedQuantity
methods.description: Calculates the net outstanding quantity ordered for a productId, considering cancellations.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantities
methods.description: Gets the outstanding quantities for a collection of productIds for a specified order type.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantitiesForSalesOrders
methods.description: Retrieves outstanding product quantities specifically for sales orders.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantitiesForPurchaseOrders
methods.description: Retrieves outstanding product quantities specifically for purchase orders.
